output.diagnosis: spec_error: DWELL without max_speed counts transit time (1.835s >1.5s) as stay, so 0ms still passes. Prior max_speed-only patches fix it but regress on jitter/occlusion because noisy low-conf centers inflate speed over ~1/3s and break still-time.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample stays FAIL (0ms still <1500ms, transit speed ~0.118/s >0.07/s ignored). Canonical stopped stays PASS after jitter filtered; occluded bridged instead of false FAIL.
proposals.rationale: 'stay 1.5s' means nearly-still time. 0.07/s is well below belt transit speed but above stopped jitter, plus confidence filtering stabilizes speed and larger gap bridges occlusion after filtering.

proposals.expected_effect: Same FAIL on counterexample with stricter stillness; stronger filtering recovers canonical/occluded still-time while drive-through high-conf motion still rejected.
proposals.rationale: Keep original 0.05 stopped definition to guarantee drive-through rejection, add aggressive low-conf rejection and bridging to prevent noisy speed spikes from breaking true dwells.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample FAILs (transit >0.08/s). More tolerant than 0.05 so fewer canonical regressions, still below ~0.118/s belt speed to keep fix.
proposals.rationale: Intermediate stopped threshold balances stillness intent vs tracker jitter without raising above drive-through speed, with light confidence filtering.
